trace_caveat: All request counters checked; detailed event samples are bounded to four/store and16/evaluation with exact omissions. Failed terms are included in8670 observed calls; they are not successful throughput.
inference: Fixed first-use cost is localized to first byte and coincides with guest linear-memory growth. Empty transfer Vec allocates on first push. Host Config uses dynamic memory with zero spare growth reservation; pinned Wasmtime20.0.2 MmapMemory::grow_to allocates and copies prior accessible bytes when reservation is exceeded. Relocation/copy is a strong explanation, but no allocator/copy time is measured directly and there is no counterfactual yet.
next_step: A separately identified qualification-only A/B of zero versus a small bounded dynamic growth reservation, preserving guest bytes/calls, fresh state, visible linear-memory caps, fuel and failure semantics. Compare ordinary timings plus total lifecycle/RSS/cleanup; reserve any production adoption and gate changes until the comparison passes.
limitations: Only two warm samples per row; batch1 has material order/scheduler/observer variation
